title: WSU Gets Much-Needed Feel-Good Win vs. Duquesne, 48-7

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: WSU Gets Much-Needed Feel-Good Win vs. Duquesne, 48-7
sources.description: Washington State defeated the Duquesne Dukes 48-7 Saturday afternoon at Martin Stadium behind an explosive second half. Kirby Moore earned his first-ever win as a head coach and advanced the Cougars to 1-2 on the season. After a sluggish first half that made Coug fans feel even more uneasy about their offensive woes, WSU exploded […]
